# MCP prompts

This page lists the prompts that the Tlilli MCP server (`tlilli-mcp`) offers to agents.

This version of the server offers no prompts. The first ones arrive with v0.2 ([PRD 11](../../prd/11-fr-v0.2-red-ink.md)).
